header.note: Written by the census --render-fe-fixture mode against the round-2 88.9 tree (FE b58735a, plan 88.9-50). It sits outside src so the cite walkers never see it, and it is regenerated by that mode in the same commit as any later census change. The mode writes header.included, header.excluded and entries; header.note, header.hand_resolved and hand_resolved are hand-carried and must be put back after a regeneration (src/app/haloCensus.test.ts reds while they are missing). hand_resolved holds the three header Buttons of the group home page (census B095, B096, B097), one row per arm literal, and the tinted arm of the grouplist card Button (census B075), which the mode excludes (excluded.other) because their className is not static text: each row carries the written reason naming the literal that carries its halo. No row carries a line number.
